## Description

Some AST attributes generate methods in code. SingletonAttribute is one of them.

Unfortunately, code completion in BooBinding does not seem to detect these (often important) changes.

Here is the cursory sample:

import Useful.Attributes from "Boo.Lang.Useful"

[Singleton]

class SingletonTest:

 [getter(Zap)]

 zap as int

### comment-48703

Hide

 Permalink

 Daniel Grunwald
 added a comment - 16/Oct/05 3:52 PM 

SharpDevelop does not load references into its app domain, so the attributes from referenced libraries aren't expanded.

In SharpDevelop 2.0.0.585, Boo.Lang.Useful is added to the parser references, so at least the Useful attributes will be expanded.
